account.account_id.label: unique identifier of the account
account.account_id.evidence: the id of the account; semantic_role: identifier

account.district_id.label: district id of the account's branch

client.district_id.label: district id of the client's branch

disp.account_id.label: account id linked to this disposition

disp.client_id.label: client id linked to this disposition

disp.disp_id.label: unique identifier of this disposition record
disp.disp_id.evidence: unique number of identifying this row of record

disp.type.label: client's role on account (owner, user, or disponent)

district.A6.label: number of municipalities with 500-1999 inhabitants
district.A6.evidence: municipalities with 500-1999 inhabitants (catalogue); municipality < district < region

district.A7.label: number of municipalities with 2000-9999 inhabitants
district.A7.evidence: municipalities with 2000-9999 inhabitants (catalogue); municipality < district < region

district.A8.label: number of municipalities with over 10000 inhabitants
district.A8.evidence: municipalities with over 10000 inhabitants (catalogue); municipality < district < region

district.district_id.label: unique identifier of the district
district.district_id.evidence: semantic_role: identifier; column is the primary key of the district table itself

loan.account_id.label: account id of the account holding the loan
loan.account_id.evidence: the id number identifying the account

loan.loan_id.label: unique identifier of the loan
loan.loan_id.evidence: the id number identifying the loan data

loan.status.label: loan repayment status (finished/running, paid/in debt)
loan.status.evidence: repayment status; 'A' contract finished, no problems; 'B' contract finished, loan not paid; 'C' running contract, OK so far; 'D' running contract, client in debt

order.account_id.label: account id that issued the order

trans.account.label: account number of the transaction partner

trans.account_id.label: id of the account owning this transaction

trans.operation.label: mode of the transaction (cash, card, or transfer)
trans.operation.evidence: mode of transaction; "VYBER KARTOU": credit card withdrawal, "VKLAD": credit in cash, "PREVOD Z UCTU": collection from another bank, "VYBER": withdrawal in cash, "PREVOD NA UCET": remittance to another bank

trans.type.label: transaction direction (credit or withdrawal)
trans.type.evidence: +/- transaction; "PRIJEM" stands for credit, "VYDAJ" stands for withdrawal

disp.evidence: one client's role (owner/disponent) on an account

order.evidence: one standing/permanent payment order on an account
